items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: We come down to open in El Dorado for two weeks with Little Jimmy Scott... She worked the second week and brought her brother back, who could play terrific trombone, [Ellick Chaplain. Chapman,]

ctx.x: get to Atlanta, Georgia, a long distance called in, and her brother called her. She said, 'Mother killed Daddy.' And she wanted to leave them there. In Atlanta, I said, 'We're going to Jackson, Mississippi. It'd be cheaper for you to go (inaudible). Come on, ride with us. You can't get there any faster. And ain't nothing you can do yet anyway.'

So she run on into Jackson. I got a plane flight out of there for her. It was less money than going from -- come into Corpus Christi where her family were. We come down to open in El Dorado for two weeks with Little Jimmy Scott, August, 1954. And my wife and the guy that drives for me and valet with me, Red, they drove to Corpus Christi and attended the funeral. So she didn't work the first week with me. She worked the second week and brought her brother back, who could play terrific trombone, [Ellick Chaplain.…
